source_request: Measure whether the redesigned checkout CTA improves completed purchases.
trigger: Customer selects the checkout CTA on the cart page

primary_metric.name: completed_order_session_rate
primary_metric.numerator: eligible sessions linked to at least one completed order
primary_metric.denominator: eligible cart sessions exposed to a test variant

open_questions: How are cross-device orders linked to sessions?
What is the refund and late-order window?
